Title: Verify successful login with valid username and password redirects to Dashboard
Precondition: The OrangeHRM QA login page is reachable at https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login. A valid registered account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. No active session exists in the browser.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: Login page loads showing the OrangeHRM logo/branding, Username field, Password field, Login button, and the 'Forgot your password?' link | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the field labelled 'Username' → Expected: Username field shows 'Admin'; no validation message is displayed | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the field labelled 'Password' → Expected: Password field shows masked characters; no validation message is displayed | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: Within 3 seconds the user is redirected to the Dashboard (URL contains /dashboard/index) and the top-bar user menu is displayed
Expected Result: The user is authenticated, an authenticated session is created, and the Dashboard is displayed.

Title: Verify login fails with 'Invalid credentials' for a wrong password
Precondition: The login page is reachable and the account username 'Admin' exists. No active session exists.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the OrangeHRM login page → Expected: Login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: Username field shows 'Admin' | 3. Enter 'wrongPass999' into the Password field → Expected: Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: An 'Invalid credentials' error message is displayed and the URL remains on the login page; no redirect to Dashboard occurs
Expected Result: Authentication is denied, 'Invalid credentials' is shown, and the user remains on the Login page.

Title: Verify login fails with 'Invalid credentials' for an unknown username with a valid password
Precondition: The login page is reachable. Username 'NonExistentUser' does not correspond to any account. No active session exists.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the OrangeHRM login page → Expected: Login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'NonExistentUser' into the Username field → Expected: Username field shows the entered value | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: An 'Invalid credentials' error message is displayed; the user remains on the Login page and is not redirected
Expected Result: Login is denied with a generic 'Invalid credentials' message that does not reveal whether the username or password was incorrect.

Title: Verify 'Required' validation appears for blank Username, blank Password, and both blank
Precondition: The login page is reachable and no active session exists. Both fields start empty.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page and leave both Username and Password empty, then click 'Login' → Expected: A 'Required' validation message is shown under both the Username and Password fields; no redirect occurs | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field, leave Password empty, then click 'Login' → Expected: A 'Required' message is shown under the Password field only; authentication does not proceed | 3. Clear the Username field, enter 'admin123' into the Password field, then click 'Login' → Expected: A 'Required' message is shown under the Username field only; authentication does not proceed
Expected Result: Field-level 'Required' messages display for each empty mandatory field and the login process is blocked until both fields are provided.

Title: Verify Password field masks entered characters on screen
Precondition: The login page is reachable and the Password field is empty.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: Login form is displayed with an empty Password field | 2. Type 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: The Password field displays masked characters (dots/asterisks), not the literal text 'admin123' | 3. Inspect the Password input's type attribute via browser dev tools → Expected: The input element has type='password', confirming masking is applied at the DOM level
Expected Result: The password is visually masked and stored in a password-type input; the plain-text value is never rendered on screen.

Title: Verify pressing Enter with valid credentials submits the login equivalent to clicking Login
Precondition: The login page is reachable and a valid account 'Admin' / 'admin123' exists. No active session exists.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page and enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: Username field shows 'Admin' | 2. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: Password field shows masked characters | 3. With focus in the Password field, press the Enter key → Expected: The login request is submitted and the user is redirected to the Dashboard, identical to clicking the 'Login' button
Expected Result: Enter-key submission authenticates the user and navigates to the Dashboard, matching the Login button behavior.

Title: Verify pressing Enter with blank fields triggers 'Required' validation and does not silently submit
Precondition: The login page is reachable and both fields are empty.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page and leave both fields empty → Expected: Login form is displayed with empty fields | 2. Place focus in the Username field and press the Enter key → Expected: A 'Required' validation message is displayed for the empty field(s); no authentication request is submitted and no redirect occurs
Expected Result: Enter with blank fields shows 'Required' validation and blocks submission, matching the Login button.

Title: Verify leading and trailing spaces in Username are trimmed before authentication
Precondition: The login page is reachable and the account 'Admin' / 'admin123' exists. No active session exists.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page and enter '  Admin  ' (with a leading and trailing space) into the Username field → Expected: Username field shows the value including the spaces | 2. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: Password field shows masked characters | 3. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: The surrounding spaces are trimmed, the credentials match, and the user is redirected to the Dashboard
Expected Result: The Username is trimmed prior to validation and login succeeds despite the leading/trailing spaces.

Title: Verify Password leading/trailing spaces are preserved and NOT trimmed
Precondition: The login page is reachable and the account 'Admin' / 'admin123' exists. No active session exists.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page and enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: Username field shows 'Admin' | 2. Enter ' admin123 ' (with a leading and trailing space) into the Password field → Expected: Password field shows masked characters for the padded value | 3. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: Authentication uses the exact typed value (spaces preserved), which does not match the stored password, so 'Invalid credentials' is displayed and the user remains on the Login page
Expected Result: Password spaces are not trimmed; the padded password does not match and login is rejected with 'Invalid credentials'.

Title: Verify 'Forgot your password?' link navigates to the Password Reset page
Precondition: The login page is reachable and no active session exists.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the OrangeHRM login page → Expected: The 'Forgot your password?' link is visible on the login form | 2. Click the 'Forgot your password?' link → Expected: The browser navigates to the Password Reset page (URL contains /auth/requestPasswordResetCode) showing the Reset Password form with a Username field and a 'Reset Password' button
Expected Result: The user is taken from the Login page to the Password Reset page.

Title: Verify Logout returns to Login and browser Back cannot restore the authenticated Dashboard
Precondition: A valid account 'Admin' / 'admin123' exists and the login page is reachable. The browser starts with no active session.
Steps: 1. Log in with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123' and click 'Login' → Expected: User is authenticated and the Dashboard is displayed | 2. Open the top-right user dropdown menu and click 'Logout' → Expected: The user is returned to the Login page (URL contains /auth/login) and the login form is displayed | 3. Click the browser Back button → Expected: The Dashboard is NOT restored; the application redirects to the Login page because the session is invalidated
Expected Result: Logout terminates the session and the Back button cannot re-access the Dashboard; the user stays on the Login page.

Title: Verify direct navigation to a protected URL without a session redirects to Login
Precondition: The browser has no active session (logged out / fresh session).
Steps: 1. Ensure no user is logged in, then enter the protected URL https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/dashboard/index directly in the address bar → Expected: The application does not render the Dashboard | 2. Observe the resulting page → Expected: The user is redirected to the Login page (URL contains /auth/login) and the login form is displayed
Expected Result: Protected pages are inaccessible without an active session; the user is redirected to Login.

Title: Verify an already-authenticated user visiting the Login page is redirected to the Dashboard
Precondition: The user is already logged in as 'Admin' with an active session and is on the Dashboard.
Steps: 1. While logged in, enter the login URL https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login in the address bar → Expected: The login form is not shown | 2. Observe the resulting page → Expected: The application redirects the active user to the Dashboard (URL contains /dashboard/index)
Expected Result: An authenticated user requesting the Login page is redirected to the Dashboard instead of seeing the login form.

Title: Verify credentials are submitted via HTTPS POST and never appear in the URL or query string
Precondition: Browser developer tools are available with the Network tab open. A valid account 'Admin' / 'admin123' exists.
Steps: 1. Open browser dev tools, select the Network tab, and navigate to the login page → Expected: The page loads over an https:// scheme | 2. Enter 'Admin' and 'admin123' and click 'Login' while capturing network traffic → Expected: A validate/login request is captured using the POST method to an https endpoint | 3. Inspect the captured login request's method, URL, and payload → Expected: The request method is POST; the username and password are present only in the request body/form data, not in the URL or query string | 4. Open the browser history and address bar after login → Expected: The URL/query string and browser history contain no username or password values
Expected Result: Credentials are transmitted via HTTPS POST in the request body and never exposed in the URL, query string, or history.

Title: Verify brute-force protection engages after repeated invalid login attempts
Precondition: The login page is reachable and the username 'Admin' exists. No active session exists.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page and submit 'Admin' with the incorrect password 'wrongPass000' → Expected: 'Invalid credentials' is displayed | 2. Repeat the incorrect-password submission for 'Admin' several times in quick succession (e.g., 6 consecutive failures) → Expected: Each attempt is rejected with 'Invalid credentials' | 3. Observe the application's behavior after the threshold of failed attempts is exceeded → Expected: Brute-force protection engages — for example a temporary lockout, throttling/delay, or a CAPTCHA challenge is presented rather than allowing unlimited attempts
Expected Result: After repeated failures the application enforces brute-force protection instead of accepting unlimited login attempts.
